steps.say: Click the middle column to drop your first piece. It falls to the lowest empty spot, and the middle gives you more ways to build a line.
Four in a row wins: across, up, or diagonal. You have three across the bottom. Finish the line.
steps.tip: Look along the bottom row for an open end.

steps.say: Your opponent has three across the bottom. Block the open end before they make four.
steps.tip: Their line is in columns 2, 3 and 4. Which end is still open?

steps.say: Lines can go straight up too. You have three stacked in one column. Make it four.
steps.tip: Drop on top of your own stack.
